items.mainDefect: In updateEvent in CalendarService, the fallback `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches and the update goes to the wrong calendar instead of the destination calendar.

secondary.defect: The same dead fallback in deleteEvent (around line 317) leaves calendarId undefined, so deletes go to the wrong calendar.
